submitted.rationale: Index 10 (Ca0.50Mn0.50, CaMnO3 perovskite stoichiometry) had the highest measured photocurrent, 7.9e-7 A. That is about 13x higher than the Mn-rich (Ca 0.30) and Ca-rich (Ca 0.62) points on either side of it. So the measurements point to a peak near the 1:1 composition.
